name: Unbearable Crush
source:
You play as Ringo, a powerful spirit who's been inconveniently trapped in the body of a small teddy bear. Your goal is to grant Kanna's wish: to get her noticed by the most dull guy in the world, and get him to ask her to the Spring Festival. But with other girls also vying for his attention, he may need a little nudge in the right direction. 

With your spiritual bear vision, look into the choices available for Kyousuke inside his head and… influence him to pick Kanna over the others. Or perhaps just make everyone else look bad. 

Deception and magic are all on the table. But be careful: in the no-holds-barred fight for love, everyone has something up their sleeve.  

[From [url=https://sarchalen.itch.io/unbearable-crush]itch.io[/url]]
